integrity: All proofs, source comparisons, and small-case checks are reported at their actual scope. No claim of independent certification.
scientific_limitations: Fixed finite number of independent uniform equivalence relations, one shared independent exchangeable unary predicate; no growing-agent bound, nonuniform-frame conclusion, or quenched theorem. Classical unmarked single-partition Poisson laws are prior art. Possible older colored-assembly priority risk.
title: Joint Poisson law for shared sparse propositions in independent finite S5 frames
